title: A dualizmus: közös ügyek és önállóság (A Dual Monarchy)
grammar: Concessive Connectors, Purpose Clauses & Dual Constitutional Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say which affairs were common and which were Hungarian after 1867.
I can use egyrészt … másrészt to describe two sides of the dual system.
I can explain dualism and name Andrássy's and Kossuth's views in a citizenship interview.
I can read a short text about the dual system and answer questions about it.
